description: The carrier's equitable share of litigation costs on its workers' compensation lien when a third-party action recovers (WCL §29; Kelly; Burns): gross lien (indemnity + medical), the cost-share rate (attorney fee + disbursements ÷ gross recovery), the carrier's share and the net to the plaintiff. For a motor-vehicle case, give the no-fault threshold that comes off the lien first. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core (the engine behind the app, the website calculators and the Pro Workspace); it never estimates. If an input is missing it returns status "missing" with every input still needed and calculates nothing. Returns the figures, the rate year used, the formulas with their citations (each flagged with whether it has been attorney-reviewed), and the not-legal-advice notice.

motor_vehicle_threshold.description: Optional, motor-vehicle cases: the amount that comes off the lien first, in dollars.
